# Data Dictionary — Synthetic Borrower Profile

**Source System:** CRM / Customer Master System  
**File:** Generated by `01_source_data/load_scripts/03_generate_borrower_profile.py`  
**Delimiter:** Comma (`,`)  
**Header Row:** Yes  
**Encoding:** UTF-8  
**Grain:** One row per customer  

## Overview

The borrower profile file represents the bank's internal Customer Master record —
the CRM view of the customer independent of any specific product holding.
It is synthetically generated using `LOAN_SEQUENCE_NUMBER` from the Freddie Mac
origination file as the join key, ensuring one customer per loan for the demo.

This file contains the richest set of customer identity, segmentation, and
relationship management attributes — columns that a BA would need to carefully
map to the Customer entity in the domain model.

## Columns

| Column Name | Type | Nullable | Description |
|-------------|------|----------|-------------|
| CUSTOMER_ID | VARCHAR(20) | N | Bank-assigned unique customer identifier. Format: CUS-XXXXXXXX. Primary key. |
| LOAN_SEQUENCE_NUMBER | CHAR(12) | N | Foreign key linking to Freddie Mac origination file. |
| CUSTOMER_TITLE | VARCHAR(10) | Y | Customer salutation (renamed from TITLE — reserved word in Teradata). Mr, Mrs, Ms, Dr, Prof. |
| FIRST_NAME | VARCHAR(50) | N | Customer first name. |
| LAST_NAME | VARCHAR(50) | N | Customer last name (family name). |
| DATE_OF_BIRTH | DATE | N | Customer date of birth. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. |
| GENDER | CHAR(1) | Y | M=Male, F=Female, X=Non-binary/Not stated. |
| EMAIL_ADDRESS | VARCHAR(100) | Y | Primary email address for digital communications. |
| MOBILE_NUMBER | VARCHAR(20) | Y | Mobile phone number. Format: +61 4XX XXX XXX (Australian). |
| HOME_PHONE | VARCHAR(20) | Y | Home landline number. |
| ADDRESS_LINE_1 | VARCHAR(100) | N | Primary residential address line 1. |
| ADDRESS_LINE_2 | VARCHAR(100) | Y | Address line 2 (unit/apartment number, etc.). |
| SUBURB | VARCHAR(60) | N | Suburb or town name. |
| STATE | CHAR(3) | N | Australian state abbreviation. NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA, TAS, ACT, NT. |
| POSTCODE | CHAR(4) | N | Australian 4-digit postcode. |
| CUSTOMER_SEGMENT | VARCHAR(30) | Y | CRM segment classification. Values: Mass Market, Emerging Affluent, Affluent, Private Banking, Business Owner. |
| RELATIONSHIP_START_DATE | DATE | N | Date the customer first became a customer of the bank. |
| PREFERRED_CONTACT_CHANNEL | VARCHAR(20) | Y | Customer's preferred communication channel. Email, Mobile, Post, Branch. |
| DIGITAL_BANKING_ENROLLED | CHAR(1) | N | Whether customer is enrolled in digital banking. Y=Yes, N=No. |
| DIGITAL_BANKING_LAST_LOGIN | DATE | Y | Date of most recent digital banking login. Null if never logged in. |
| BRANCH_CODE | CHAR(6) | Y | Home branch code for branch-aligned customers. |
| RELATIONSHIP_MANAGER_ID | VARCHAR(20) | Y | Employee ID of assigned relationship manager. Populated for Affluent and above segments. |
| ANNUAL_INCOME | DECIMAL(15,2) | Y | Declared annual gross income in AUD. |
| INCOME_VERIFIED_FLAG | CHAR(1) | Y | Whether income has been formally verified. Y=Verified, N=Self-declared. |
| EMPLOYMENT_STATUS | VARCHAR(30) | Y | Employment status at time of last review. Full-time, Part-time, Self-employed, Contractor, Retired, Unemployed. |
| EMPLOYER_NAME | VARCHAR(100) | Y | Name of employer. Null for self-employed/retired/unemployed. |
| YEARS_WITH_EMPLOYER | DECIMAL(4,1) | Y | Tenure with current employer in years. |
| CITIZENSHIP_STATUS | VARCHAR(30) | Y | Australian citizenship or residency status. Citizen, Permanent Resident, Temporary Resident, Non-Resident. |
| KYC_STATUS | VARCHAR(20) | N | Know Your Customer verification status. Verified, Pending, Expired, Failed. |
| KYC_VERIFICATION_DATE | DATE | Y | Date KYC verification was last completed. |
| AML_RISK_RATING | CHAR(1) | N | Anti-Money Laundering risk rating. L=Low, M=Medium, H=High. |
| LAST_CONTACT_DATE | DATE | Y | Date of most recent contact by bank (any channel). |
| NPS_SCORE | INTEGER | Y | Net Promoter Score from most recent survey. Range: -100 to 100. |
| CHURN_RISK_SCORE | DECIMAL(5,2) | Y | Model-generated churn propensity score. Range: 0.00–1.00. Higher = higher churn risk. |
| CHURN_RISK_BAND | VARCHAR(10) | Y | Banded churn risk label. Low (<0.3), Medium (0.3–0.6), High (>0.6). |
| MARKETING_OPT_IN | CHAR(1) | N | Marketing communications opt-in status. Y=Opted in, N=Opted out. |
| DECEASED_FLAG | CHAR(1) | N | Y=Deceased, N=Active. |
| RECORD_CREATED_DATE | DATE | N | Date the CRM record was created. |
| RECORD_LAST_UPDATED | DATE | N | Date the CRM record was most recently updated. |

## Key Business Rules

- `CUSTOMER_ID` is the bank's master customer identifier — all product systems should reference this
- A customer may hold multiple loans; this demo uses a 1:1 ratio for simplicity
- `AML_RISK_RATING` is a regulated field — any domain model handling this must consider data governance controls
- `CHURN_RISK_SCORE` is a model output, not a raw CRM field — it represents a pre-computed score loaded back into the CRM
- Australian address format differs from US Freddie Mac data — `STATE` uses Australian state codes, `POSTCODE` is 4 digits

## Domain Model Target Entities

| Source Column(s) | Target Entity | Notes |
|-----------------|---------------|-------|
| CUSTOMER_ID | Customer | Primary key in domain |
| FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, DATE_OF_BIRTH, GENDER | Customer | Identity attributes |
| EMAIL_ADDRESS, MOBILE_NUMBER, HOME_PHONE | CustomerContact | Contact entity |
| ADDRESS_LINE_1..POSTCODE | CustomerAddress | Address entity |
| CUSTOMER_SEGMENT, RELATIONSHIP_MANAGER_ID | CustomerSegment | Segmentation |
| ANNUAL_INCOME, EMPLOYMENT_STATUS | CustomerFinancial | Financial profile |
| KYC_STATUS, AML_RISK_RATING | CustomerCompliance | Regulatory attributes |
| CHURN_RISK_SCORE, NPS_SCORE | CustomerInsight | Analytically-derived |
